newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB to propose rights issue - dealers.
newsitem.headline: OUB to propose rights issue - dealers.

text.p: Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) is expected to propose a rights issue when it announces its 1996 results later today, dealers said on Friday.
Dealers said the rights share would be priced at Singapore S$4.00 each for the local tranche and at S$6.91 for the foreign shares.
OUB shares are suspended today. The closing price for the local and foreign shares were S$6.25 and S$10.80 respectively on Thursday.
A bank spokeman declined comment when contacted by Reuters.
Dealers were divided about the basis of the rights issue and the amount of money to be raised.
A dealer with a local firm said the rights issue would be on a one-for-four basis while a dealer with a foreigh institution said it was one-for-five.
Analysts said the fund raising would be in line with the bank's plans to raise its capital base.
Last year, OUB president Peter Seah said the bank would continue to strengthen its capital base to maximise business potential in Singapore and the region.
